hyperedges.rationale: All three subsystems work together: trigger modes provide entry points, roles gate access, changes workflow implements the autonomous behavior. Each trigger mode (DM, mention, reaction) checks roles before allowing changes.
Docker setup manages credentials (SSH keys, API keys, Slack tokens); role system controls who can use those credentials in the application; together they provide secure multi-user deployment
Error handling captures conversation traces and stores them in sessions; changes workflow persists session state and execution logs; together they provide comprehensive observability for debugging
